info.title: fmd-web API
info.description: fmd-web server API (DESIGN.md §10). Contract-based: every schema here is generated from the zod source of truth (server/src/api/schemas.ts); the committed snapshot (server/src/api/openapi.snapshot.json) fails CI on unintended drift. Errors use one typed envelope: { error: { code, message, details? } }.

get.summary: FTS5 search with cursor pagination (§6.5, §10) + FMD2 filter panel (additive)
get.description: Sanitized FTS MATCH over the sidecar, ranked; `cursor` continues a previous page (opaque, query-bound — it carries the FULL filter state). Catalogs are read-only after install, so cursors stay stable. FMD2 Filter-panel parity (frmMain.pas:3400, additive): `q` is optional when any filter is set (filter-only pages skip the MATCH and order by jdn DESC); `authors` is a LIKE-contains over the authors column; `genres` (repeated params or one comma-separated value) joins per `genresMode` — `all` (FMD2 rbAll default) ANDs the LIKE clauses, `any` (rbAny) ORs them; `newDays` is the only-new window (jdn > JDN(today) - newDays, FMD2 cbOnlyNew). Prefix-LIKE (`x%`) is a documented non-goal: FMD2 semantics are contains (`%x%`). §6.8 fallback: catalog-less modules search their §6.8-normalized directory-walk snapshot in memory (title/alttitles/summary terms, exact status, substring genre) with the SAME cursor scheme; `source` discriminates the channel.

200.description: Ranked page of catalog entries (source discriminator per §6.8)

400.description: Malformed cursor

get.summary: All-sites union search over installed catalogs (FMD2 cbSearchFromAllSites parity)
get.description: FMD2 parity (frmMain.pas:3411-3416): the union runs simultaneously over every INSTALLED catalog of every enabled site — a LOCAL catalog union, never live scraping. Per-site FTS windows (width 2×limit) are merged by a documented deterministic total order — (normalized title, site id, link) — so result order and cursor bytes are identical under any permutation of the site set. `cursor` continues each site window (base64 of per-site consumed-row counts, bound to the issued filter state; page-size independent). Every row carries `site` + `siteName` (FMD2 shows the source Website on union rows, frmMain.pas:5170). Partial failure is TYPED, never silent: a broken catalog yields the rest of the union plus a `warnings[]` entry naming it; enabled sites without an installed catalog are excluded and surfaced in `excluded[]` (reason `no-catalog`) so the UI chip can explain why. `facets[]` carries per-site totals for the count chips.

200.description: Merged page of site-tagged entries + facets/warnings/excluded

post.description: With `idempotencyKey`: an identical-key replay returns the ORIGINAL job with 200 while it is live (queued/running/retry); key reuse with a DIFFERENT payload returns 409. Re-enqueueing a TERMINAL original (done/failed/cancelled) starts a FRESH job chained under the same key (`<key>#<n>`, 201) — the re-download semantic; the fresh attempt resumes from the persisted chapter markers ('D' slots skip their images). Fresh creates return 201.

The §4/§15 series in Prometheus text format (version 0.0.4): queue depth per lane, job throughput/failure by state, per-module request latency + error counts, corpus pass rates, engine pool RSS + GC stats, sync progress, and the expression-failure WARN dedup counters. Mounted only when a metrics registry is bound (the production assembly always binds one).
